name: structural-scanner-crate
body: The `src/structlib` crate and its `structfrontend` binary: the single self-contained Rust artifact that walks a checkout, claims the structural files, and streams their `File`/`Struct`/`contains` records. It absorbs the `src/mdlib` Markdown frontend, so the `md` stream id for Markdown is served by `structlib` (the Markdown parser lives in `rust.structfrontend.md`). Scan-time deps are none, its runtime is self-contained, and its engine pin is its crates.
